title: An officer cannot add a note to a case: the only text they can write is the completion remarks when they close it
repro: Not run in the browser (the journeys never ran, see the report). Read the code: the drawer footer (Drawer.tsx:188 onward) offers only Approve, Complete & close or Complete & send. The step route accepts only `z.object({ step: z.literal("approve") })` (route.ts:23).
root_cause: The workflow has only approve and report steps. There is no step for a note.

title: Once /track shows a status, the page has no way to check another number or go back to the form
repro: Not run in the browser. Read the code: the form renders only when `!view` (line 37). The result card (line 45 onward) has no button that clears `view`, so checking a second slip means reloading the page.
root_cause: The page has no reset or 'check another' control.

title: The officer board's 'Resolved this month' tile says 445 but opens a list titled 'Verified by the Collector' that holds 362: the tile is the Collector overview's figure, the list is the officer's Verified tab (which also holds the cases the department closed itself, so the list title is wrong too)
root_cause: the tile counts the Collector overview's resolved incidents, the list counts the officer stage 'verified' by report date

title: Six unit tests mix SQLite own clock (datetime(now) in the test schema) with the app JS clock, so they fail whenever the process clock is moved (future-clock runs): they cannot check those paths for date time bombs
repro: QA_FROZEN_NOW=<+30d> QA_CLOCK_TICKING=1 NODE_OPTIONS=--require tests/qa/pass4/freeze-clock.cjs node tests/qa/pass6/suite.mjs --tag future-30
failing_test: src/lib/manu/manu.sqlite.test.ts (4), src/lib/manu/sms.pass5.test.ts (1), src/app/api/collector/decisions/route.sqlite.test.ts (1) under a moved clock
root_cause: test schemas use DEFAULT (datetime(now,+330 minutes)) and inserts with SQLite datetime(now): SQLite reads the wall clock while the store dialect NOW() reads JS Date; in production both are the wall clock, so this is a test-harness limit, not a product bug

title: Pass 5 known-failure probes ML-14 and ML-16 fail on this tree for a harness reason: their copy of collector_decisions has no decision_id, which the open check before an attach now reads (pass 5 P5-016), so every live attach in that harness throws

title: An officer's answer carries the district-wide incident count (all departments) in its 'as of' layer line
repro: Code path: any officer answer whose layers include 'incidents' with no w.meta entry -> asOf.layers[].count = w.incidents.length.
root_cause: The layer meta is built from the whole world, not the officer's locked set.
